nina.l: Quick sync — we want to run a tiered-vs-flat pricing A/B for EU early-adopters next week. Main asks: FX rounding, exemptions flow, and invoice tagging.
omar.g: FX note - invoices are in EUR; run proforma with yesterday's rate and +/-1% sensitivity. Rounding to cents can flip VAT lines.
rachel.c: I'll run a proforma for top 40 EU customers and post CSV. Also adding invoice.metadata.exp_id + invoice.metadata.variant so analytics can filter.
billing-bot: [automated] Experiment queued: exp_eu_pricing_ab | start=2026-07-13 | cohort=EU_early | variants=[tiered,flat]
omar.g: Exemptions: sales will file SFDC case tag "eu-pricing-exempt". Auto-approve if ARR < 10k EUR; finance sign-off if >=10k; legal if >50k.
nina.l: Success criteria: <=2 customers >15% net change OR no single >20k EUR. If exceeded we pause.
rachel.c: CSV uploaded s3://redwood-finance/ab_sim_1769000001.csv. Two customers flagged (cust_22, cust_89). I'll DM details.
billing-bot: [automated] Scheduled window set for 1769558400 (2026-07-23 08:00:00 PT)
nina.l: Thanks — ops will add monitoring alerts for median percent_delta and export a canary for 10 customers first.
